Grandma Irving is known for her strict nature. She expects those around her to follow her instructions precisely.

## History

Grandma Irving raised her son on porridge and brought him up according to her own strict methods. Through her upbringing, she successfully made a brilliant success of him.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)_

## Relationships

### [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--mary-joe.md)

[Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) serves as a domestic helper in Grandma Irving's household. In this role, she works under Grandma Irving's direction and receives commands regarding her household duties.

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

Grandma Irving is the grandmother of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She shares a familial bond with him as part of the [Irving](../character/irving.md) family.
